answer:
The simulation is run with rhoCentralFoam, not pimpleFoam.
Use a 2D rectangular domain 1.0 m long in the x direction and 0.4 m high in the y direction, extruded one cell in z from z = 0 to 0.01 m.
Name the front and back patches frontAndBack and set them to empty.
Create the mesh with blockMesh using a uniform grid of 500 cells in x, 200 cells in y, and 1 cell in z, giving 0.002 m cells.
Place a centered inlet patch of height 0.02 m on the left boundary, spanning y = 0.19 m to 0.21 m, and name it inlet.
Set the remaining portion of the left boundary, and the right, top, and bottom boundaries, as far-field open patches.
Set the inlet patch to fixedValue uniform (686 0 0) for U, fixedValue uniform 101325 for p, and fixedValue uniform 300 for T.
Set far-field patches to waveTransmissive for p and T, with pInf = 101325 and TInf = 300, and zeroGradient for U.
Set initial conditions in the domain to p = 101325 Pa, T = 300 K, and U = (0 0 0) m/s.
In constant/thermophysicalProperties, use hePsiThermo, sutherland transport, hConst thermodynamics, and perfectGas equation of state for air with Cp = 1005 J/kg/K and Cv = 718 J/kg/K.
In constant/turbulenceProperties, set simulationType laminar.
There are no solid wall patches in this baseline setup; if a solid wall is added, use noSlip on it.
In system/controlDict, set application rhoCentralFoam.
Set endTime to 0.005 s and adjust deltaT to keep an initial Courant number below 1, with writeControl adjustableRunTime and writeInterval 0.00025 s.
